plain: This story is about US nuclear missile bases in the 1960s. The claim is that between September 1966 and March 1967, the United States lost 30 missiles to UFO activity, meaning the weapons were put out of action while strange objects were reported nearby. Podcast host Jesse Michels tells it and credits a researcher named Bob Hastings and his book, UFOs and Nukes. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer who was a guest on the show, tells the same figures in his own words. Salas names two Air Force bases, Minot in North Dakota and Malmstrom in Montana. The tellers raise it because, if true, something unknown was able to interfere with America's nuclear weapons.
